name: Mermaidcore
garments: flowing fabric that moves like water

media.title: The Little Mermaid (1989/2023)
media.note: the recurring cultural touchstone, though the aesthetic is broader than any one film

reacts_against: land-bound, matte, neutral fashion palettes — mermaidcore is explicitly about iridescence and movement.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Seashells, pearls, fish scales (sequins, paillettes), coral, waves, iridescent textures, crochet/netting, starfish
wiki_facts.key_colours: Aquamarine, seafoam green, lilac, coral pink, iridescent silvers and blues, jewel tones

findings: mostly muted — about 83% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
